title: Asian Games: Philippines eyes MMA golds after securing 2 bronzes

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Team Philippines is assured of at least two more bronze medals in the Asian Games 2026 after Jean Claude Saclag and Carlos Alvarez reached the semifinals of their respective mixed martial arts weight classes on Sunday at Nagoya City Inae Sports Center. Saclag won by unanimous decision against Saudi Arabia’s Saud Fawaz Alholem, 3-0, in the men’s traditional -65kg quarterfinal. But Saclag, a former Wushu world champion now competing in MMA, is “101 percent” confident that he will win the gold. “Now, I still have the mentality that I’m still going to compete.
